## Task
- Objective: Classify each rice grain as Cammeo or Osmancik using morphological measurements taken from an image of the grain, so that a mill can sort grains automatically.
- Target: `Class` (binary_classification)
- Primary metric: `roc_auc` (maximize)

## Summary
The run aimed to classify Cammeo and Osmancik rice grains from image-derived measurements for automated sorting. It compared regularized linear and histogram-based classifiers, then delivered a standardized, L-two-regularized logistic regression; the platform reports the model as verified.

- Test accuracy: 0.9388; test balanced accuracy: 0.9393.
